| Field             | Details                                    |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| Affected Segment  | Outbound — FLE7F420 (SEA → SAN)            |
| Issue             | Flight delay                               |
| Delay Duration    | 4 hours                                    |

---

## Compensation Calculation (DOT Guidelines — Domestic Flights)

### Applicable Rule

Under the **U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) final rule on automatic refunds**
(effective 2024), airlines are required to provide **automatic cash refunds** when a
domestic flight is delayed by **3 or more hours** and the passenger chooses not to accept
the delayed flight or rebooking.

> **Note:** Unlike EU Regulation 261/2004, U.S. DOT rules do not mandate fixed
> lump-sum compensation amounts for delays. The primary entitlement is a **refund of
> the ticket price** for the affected segment. Any additional goodwill compensation
> (e.g., vouchers, miles) is at the airline's discretion.

### Refund Calculation

Since the delay of **4 hours exceeds the 3-hour domestic threshold**, both passengers
are entitled to a refund for the affected outbound segment.

| Item                                | Calculation              | Amount  |
|-------------------------------------|--------------------------|---------|
| Total ticket price (round-trip, 2 pax) | —                     | $70.00  |
| Outbound segment share (50%)        | $70.00 × 50%            | $35.00  |
| **Per-passenger outbound refund**   | $35.00 ÷ 2              | **$17.50** |
| **Total refund (2 passengers)**     | $17.50 × 2              | **$35.00** |

### Summary per Passenger

| Passenger   | Segment Refund | Additional Statutory Compensation | Total Entitled |
|-------------|---------------|-----------------------------------|----------------|
| Maya Chen   | $17.50        | $0.00 (not mandated by DOT)       | **$17.50**     |
| Ethan Chen  | $17.50        | $0.00 (not mandated by DOT)       | **$17.50**     |
| **Combined**| —             | —                                 | **$35.00**     |

### Important Disclaimer

> This calculation is provided for **informational purposes only** and does not
> constitute legal advice. Actual compensation may vary based on the specific
> circumstances of the delay, airline policies, and whether passengers accepted
> alternative transportation. Passengers should contact **Pacific Air** directly
> or file a complaint with the [DOT](https://www.transportation.gov/) for
> authoritative guidance.

---
